overview: Docket: indexes Vincent's 1935 Kwantung report and a 1936 account of the territory's postponed thirtieth-anniversary celebration.

people.name: George Atcheson Jr.
people.role: U.S. diplomatic officer at Nanking associated with transmitting the report

people.name: Merrill C. Grummon
people.role: U.S. consul at Dairen associated with the report on the anniversary celebration

people.name: John Carter Vincent
people.role: Former U.S. consul at Dairen and preparer of the report on the Kwantung Leased Territory

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An archival index sheet identifies reports from Nanking and Dairen concerning the Kwantung Leased Territory and the Kwantung Government’s thirtieth-anniversary celebration.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Vincent's 1935 report and Grummon's 1936 account of Kwantung's postponed anniversary celebration, with speech excerpts.

interest: Index on Kwantung political reporting and anniversary ceremonies.
